# GitHub Copilot Instructions

This directory contains skills and instructions for GitHub Copilot when working on this repository.

## Available Skills

### [Otto-kit Component](./hello-design-component.md)

A comprehensive guide for creating new OttoKit UI components following the established architecture pattern.

**Layers:**
- State Layer - Component state/model
- Style Layer - Visual configuration  
- Renderer Layer - Pure drawing functions
- Component Layer - Public API

**Use when:** Creating new UI components for the hello-design library.

## Usage

These instruction files are automatically read by GitHub Copilot to provide context-aware assistance when working in this repository.
